main.description: Account deletion (decision J1). Requires a bound Labyrinth device. Locally, in one transaction: purge the mailbox exactly as purgeMailbox does (including every ORF state), redact every thread item the DID authored in conversations this DS sequences with a server redaction (defs#redaction variant 2: by, reason accountDeleted, redactedAt, and a DS signature), and queue a durable purgeAuthor job for the sequencer of every other conversation the DID takes or took part in; those are delivered with retries, so an unreachable DS neither blocks nor loses the deletion. Idempotency records are kept (they expire after 7 days), so a replayed pre-deletion write answers from its record instead of running again. MEK records stay, because other members' batches can be sealed under them. Common errors: NotAuthorized, AccountSessionExpired, DeviceRevoked, RateLimited, InvalidRequest, PayloadTooLarge, QuotaExceeded.
